chunks: About a man who places qazz in his cloak instead of cotton: may he pray in it?
So he wrote: "Yes, there is no problem with it."

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no problem with it; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray in a cloak containing qazz instead of cotton?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about praying in a cloak whose stuffing contains qazz instead of cotton. The reply states that there is no objection to praying in such a garment, indicating its permissibility in this case.
